name: session
description: Agent-agnostic session handoff reports and recall helpers for Codex. Writes structured reports under the project root .sessions directory and retrieves prior work through list, filter, grep, resume, and last workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Write and recall agent-agnostic session reports
interface.longDescription: Create structured handoff reports and retrieve previous work through deterministic local scripts. Reports are stored in the project root .sessions directory so future agents can resume without tying the handoff store to any vendor, product, or plugin runtime.
defaultPrompt: Write a session report for this work.
